lines: In the Vasura year, in Pauṣa, on the dark tenth — Abhinavagupta composed this hymn.
by which the pervasive, compassionate Lord in a flash stills the people’s desert-heat of becoming.
sanskrit_cite: vasurasapauṣe kṛṣṇadaśamyām abhinavaguptaḥ stavam imam akarot yena vibhuḥ bhavati janasya arusantāpaṃ śamayati jhaṭiti dayāluḥ
notes: follows bhavamaru (desert-heat of becoming) with L0/NOTE-terms against printed bhavati…arusantāpaṃ; SA untouched pending adjudication
vasurasa kept as year-name (cf. Dyczkowski Vasura-saṃvatsara)
